desc: The Inglis P-35 brings back the Hi-Power at a price point that any budget can afford. Built using forged components and high-quality 4140 button-rifled barrels for a durable, but accurate pistol. The P-35 carries on the legacy of the John Inglis Co and John Brownings' design for a new era of shooters and collectors. The electroless nickel finish and G10 grips are complimented with Browning dovetail cut sights, a ring hammer, and an extended ambidextrous safety.
